item.title: Anthropic Says AI Is Reshaping Its Workforce
item.description: Anthropic says its workforce is becoming less junior and spending more time in meetings, offering a rare glimpse into how AI changes AI labs.

item.title: DeepSeek Releases V4.1 Flash-1017 With Open Weights
item.description: DeepSeek has released a refreshed open-weight model and opened its search and fetch APIs, extending its push into low-cost agent infrastructure.

item.title: ⚡ 13 quick hits — Evening edition, Oct 17
item.description: · Ollama says its cloud service offers zero data retention, US and EU hosting, and no training on user data.（X） · OpenAI Developers highlighted community weekend projects and linked instructions for recreating them.（X） · Kyutai released REKI, a 2.4-billion-parameter open VLA with lightweight temporal memory for robot manipulation.（MarkTechPost） · Pika introduced Product Shot, which turns a kitchen-counter photo into a polished studio product image inside ChatGPT.（X） · Cohere claimed Embed 5 Fast led Google’s EmbeddingGemma 2 on more than 95% of 163 datasets.（X） · Pika’s Product Ad generated a complete commercial, including voiceover, from an armchair photo inside ChatGPT.（X） · Pika said Camera Director turns a user idea into a cinematic short through ChatGPT.（X） · GitHub announced direct integration between its AI-oriented workflow setup and Logitech’s new MX Keypad.（X） · Arena updated its Alignment Index with new labs and models, measuring unauthorized action, deception, and user-control signals from real agent sessions.（X） · Arena described its Alignment Index as being built from more than 90,000 real-world agent sessions across 30 models.（X） · Bolt made its app-building platform free for the weekend and offered a $10,000 competition prize for submissions by October 20.（X） · Akka reported testing specification-based AI delivery across 65 open-source projects.（InfoQ中文） · ServiceNow’s AI Control Tower is being positioned as an enterprise governance layer while its underlying operating model is still developing.（SiliconANGLE）

item.title: ⚡ 6 quick hits — Morning edition, Oct 17
item.description: · A new report said websites are increasingly blocking AI agents from crawling, acting, or completing tasks on their pages.（The Verge） · Kling joined WPP and Adobe at Advertising Week New York to discuss how AI is reshaping creative production.（X / Kling AI） · A QCon Shanghai session examined AI systems that continuously learn from reality rather than relying only on static datasets.（InfoQ 中文） · Latent Space’s latest AI News episode focused on high-taste testers and how expert users shape product quality.（Latent Space） · Kling published a new Kling 4 video clip showing a torch-free cooking effect in a short social post.（X / Kling AI） · Kling shared another Kling 4 clip blending fantasy imagery with nostalgic visual motifs.（X / Kling AI）
